rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: The five that pay: full stop (sentence end, abbreviations), comma (lists, clauses), apostrophe (possession/contraction), quotation marks (speech), capital letters (sentence start, proper nouns, 'I').  ·  Trick 2: Apostrophe placement: singular 'boy's', plural 'boys''; its = possessive, it's = it is — the its/it's trap is guaranteed.
